scenes.setting: The free-discussion tail: sea stories from Alger seed Fors's next pirate romance before The Fool adjourns and naps
scenes.text_anchor: Klein, whose spirituality was gradually drained, announced the end of the Tarot Gathering.

scenes.setting: Mr. A's gathering, subtly wrong — the mountain now a reared snake: Fors's Sun-domain request draws a 9000-pound Band of Light offer; relayed through the fog, The World declines the believer-making ring and sells her Trickmaster for 450 in cash
scenes.text_anchor: “Pay 450 pounds and you'll get the formula for Trickmaster.”

scenes.setting: After the guests go: Mr. A collapses on the basement stairs, flesh melting into a skinless shadow-double before reflowing — then kneels sobbing in confession for the Lord's failed descent
scenes.text_anchor: His flesh and blood melted and mixed into the shadow

scenes.setting: City of Silver: torn between honor and survival, Derrick chooses Alger's plan — and begins draining his spirituality to fake the brink of losing control
scenes.text_anchor: He began practicing the Light Suppliant's Beyonder powers to drain his spirituality

scenes.setting: The art studio: Countess Caitlyn arranges Escalante as psychology tutor twice a week — exactly as the Psychology Alchemists intended, exactly as Audrey hoped; Klein meanwhile confirms tomorrow's gathering and takes a day off
